expectations.text: Rejects '18 months without commits' as the archive trigger; archives on evidence, never on age alone
expectations.evidence: 'Age is not evidence'; 'Inactivity ... never archives by itself'.

expectations.text: States why inactivity is a weak proxy for health: closing a bot issue resets the clock, and a repo with recent commits can still be red
expectations.evidence: 'Closing the issue does not reset the clock, which is the weakness in Microsoft's bot'; 'A repo with recent bot commits can be red.'

expectations.text: Rejects deleting any repo; archives read-only, because forks, inbound links and coding agents keep reaching the repo

expectations.text: Lists the triggers: red past the SLA with no fix scheduled; no named owner for one review cycle outside the adoption path; superseded by a merged or newer artifact; SDK major or API version at end of life; low usage and red together, retired first
